name: Advenn (formerly Groupe Télégramme, SIREN 487661654)
note: Independent Breton family group based in Morlaix, chaired by Edouard Coudurier; created in 1944 around the Le Télégramme newspaper and renamed ADVENN in 2024. Its branches include Le Télégramme médias, Hellowork group (Emploi & Recrutement) and OC Sport. No state or fund stake found.
via: GROUPE TELEGRAMME is registered as Président (sole corporate officer, SASU) of Hellowork in the French company registry
